text:
Claire W.: heads up — Dedicated tenant t-8421 (customer account) is getting 429s and high p99. Customer reporting errors since ~10:10 UTC. I can see throttles firing in the tenant limiter. Can infra/ops check?
Sam I.: can you paste the tenant quota config + any recent admin changes? which pool/region is this serving from?
Claire W.: logs: `2026-03-17T10:12:02Z WARN throttle tenant=t-8421 rate=100/60s local_count=110`
Claire W.: policy snippet we have in state: `{ "tenant_id":"t-8421", "rate_limit_per_min":100, "burst":20 }` — but SLA/customer onboarding says 1000/min. Not sure who changed it.
Tom R.: autoscaler metrics show queue depth spike at 10:11, cpu on nodes fine. Important bit: scale-up attempts failed fast because requests hit tenant limiter before new workers could take load — so autoscaler never saw the request backlog as "scale-able". Might need to let autoscaler bypass tenant soft-limits.
Raj P.: I see an admin console patch at 09:55 by ops-admin: `PATCH /tenants/t-8421/quota` setting `quota_profile=restricted`. Audit id: a-8832.
support-bot: Audit entry: user=ops-admin (u-99) changed quota_profile -> restricted at 2026-03-17T09:55:12Z. https://console.redwood/internal/audit/a-8832
Sam I.: confirmed: quota_profile overrides per-tenant rate_limit immediately. Quick mitigation: revert profile to `enterprise-default` or manually bump `rate_limit_per_min` to 1000 and `burst` to 200. That should stop 429s while we root-cause the override.
Claire W.: customer impact: ~20% of requests 429, started ~10:10 and still ongoing. They've escalated to CSM.
Tom R.: executing mitigation now: `curl -s -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.internal/tenants/t-8421/quota" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" -d '{"rate_limit_per_min":1000,"burst":200}'`
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Tom R. at 2026-03-17T10:25:32Z. Job #5543.
Tom R.: patch applied, monitoring — p99 and 429 rate dropping. Will watch 30m.
Raj P.: following up with finance/ops — looks like someone applied a conservative billing safeguard on this account during a previous cost spike and never reverted. I'll open ticket FIN-776 to make the change audit clearer.
Sam I.: filing infra bug INF-1221 to add an autoscaler guard so scale-ups can proceed even if tenant soft-limiter is temporarily saturated (with safety caps).
Claire W.: thanks all — please post when the customer is clear. :thumbsup:
Tom R.: will do, marking this as mitigated for now.
_meta: generated for dataset — Slack thread representing support escalation about dedicated quota override causing throttling
